question: What division of eight groups of eight is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division consisting of eight groups of eight is mentioned.
The speaker seeks to know this division fully.
The knowing is described as endless in extent.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight groups of eight is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight.
